title: StyleMorph: Disentangled 3D-Aware Image Synthesis with a 3D Morphable StyleGAN

en.text: Modern 3D-aware GANs make gorgeous, view-consistent portraits. What they do not make is editable ones. Because their latent codes fuse geometry and appearance into a single hybrid representation, you cannot rotate a generated face without also nudging its identity, or swap the background without disturbing the subject. The pixels are beautiful; the control knobs are glued together.

The graphics world solved the control problem decades ago with 3D Morphable Models (3DMMs), the workhorse behind visual-effects pipelines and AR avatars. A 3DMM hands the artist clean, separate dials for pose, expression, and appearance. The catch is how you build one: classical 3DMMs demand 3D scanning rigs and painstaking manual alignment across a subject population, which is exactly why they mostly exist for a single category, the human face.

StyleMorph, from University College London and the Alan Turing Institute, asks whether we can get morphable-model control inside a modern generator while learning everything from nothing but unstructured 2D photos. The answer is a model that cleanly pulls apart four factors of an image, the object's 3D shape, the camera pose, the foreground appearance, and the background, and lets you edit each one independently, all while matching the image quality of the strongest 3D-aware GANs that offer none of this control.

en.caption: Figure 1. Disentangled control in StyleMorph. Starting from one synthesized sample (far left), each column changes a single factor: pose, shape, foreground appearance, or background. The rightmost column combines all four. The geometric conditioning signal (top and bottom rows) stays fixed across the foreground and background edits, so those two changes come purely from the appearance codes.

en.text: Paper: https://openreview.net/forum?id=Ojpb1y8jflw  ·  Project page: https://stylemorph.github.io/stylemorph/
Why 3D-aware GANs entangle, and what a morphable model buys you

The recent wave of 3D-aware GANs, from GIRAFFE to EG3D, earns its realism by baking a 3D inductive bias into the generator: a neural radiance field or an implicit occupancy network renders the scene volumetrically, so different viewpoints stay consistent by construction. The price is entanglement. A single style vector, or a shared feature volume, drives shape and texture together, so there is no place to reach in and change one factor without touching the others. Some hybrids add partial disentanglement, but none of them learn a reusable, category-general shape model that you can morph at will.

A morphable model is exactly that missing piece: a canonical template plus a learned space of deformations that warp it into each individual instance. If you could obtain one for arbitrary categories without 3D supervision, you would get both worlds, the photorealism of a GAN and the surgical editability of a 3DMM. StyleMorph's contribution is to make the morphable model itself something the network discovers by backpropagation, from 2D images alone.
The idea: funnel all geometry through one purely geometric bottleneck

StyleMorph has two halves that meet at a single, deliberately narrow interface. The first half is a Morphable Renderer that handles geometry. It learns a deformation-free object as a constant implicit field living in a canonical template space. A deformation field built on SIREN, driven by a shape code, warps each camera ray from world space into that template space by adding a predicted offset, r-hat(t) = r(t) + g_s(r(t)). Integrating the template coordinates along each ray produces a 2D map the authors call a TOCS map, for Template Object Coordinates.

TOCS is the conceptual heart of the paper. It is a deformable cousin of Normalized Object Coordinates: every surface point carries a stable identity in template space, so the map is a deformation-equivariant descriptor of 3D shape. Crucially, a TOCS map is exclusively geometric. It encodes the compounded effect of shape deformation, camera pose, and perspective projection, and nothing at all about texture or color. That is the bottleneck: by forcing every geometric factor through this one 2D image, and nothing else through it, StyleMorph guarantees that appearance has to enter the pipeline somewhere else.

en.caption: Figure 2. The two halves of StyleMorph. Left: a template shape, a shape code z_s, camera pose (phi, theta), and perspective projection are combined into a single 2D TOCS map that bottlenecks all geometric variation. Right: the TOCS map, plus separate foreground (z_fg) and background (z_bg) appearance codes, drives a Deferred Neural Renderer, trained against a discriminator, to produce a high-resolution image.

en.text: The second half is where appearance lives. A Deferred Neural Renderer (DNR) built on StyleGAN2 takes the geometric TOCS map together with two independent appearance codes, one for the foreground object and one for the background scene, and synthesizes a high-resolution image. Foreground and background are generated separately and composited late, through a predicted alpha mask, I = A * I_fg + (1 - A) * I_bg. Because shape and pose can only reach the renderer through the TOCS map, and the two appearance codes never touch geometry, the four factors come out cleanly separated by design rather than by a regularization penalty.

Training runs in two stages. In stage one, the deformable volume renderer is trained as a low-resolution 64-squared RGBA image generator, so it learns a realistic shape model, with only weak silhouette supervision from off-the-shelf Labels4free masks. In stage two, that renderer is frozen and its RGB block pruned; it now serves only to emit 64-squared TOCS maps, while the DNR is trained at full resolution to turn those maps plus appearance codes into photorealistic output. Splitting the work this way lets the expensive volumetric model stay small and cheap, while the 2D renderer carries the resolution.
Does the disentanglement actually hold?

The first test is whether the learned shape space is rich and whether the renderer respects it. Fixing the viewpoint and appearance codes and varying only the shape code should change face and hair geometry while leaving the rendered texture aligned to the new shape.

en.caption: Figure 5. Shape control from a fixed viewpoint. Four different shape codes yield four different TOCS maps (varying hair styles and face shapes), and the rendered RGB tracks them closely. Equicontours drawn on the template coordinates reveal dense surface correspondences that hold across shapes.

en.text: The equicontours make the point precise: the same template coordinate lands on the same semantic location across very different faces, which is what a genuine morphable model is supposed to guarantee. The next test is the full four-way edit, and whether it generalizes beyond faces to categories a classical 3DMM never covered.

en.caption: Figure 6. Independent editing of one factor at a time, across faces, cats, and wild animals. From the source (yellow border), StyleMorph varies shape (green), foreground appearance (blue), and background (red) while holding the other factors fixed.

en.text: Changing the foreground code restyles the subject without moving the geometry; changing the background code repaints the scene without touching the subject; changing the shape code alters the underlying 3D form. The same behavior holds on cats and wild animals, evidence that StyleMorph has effectively learned an unsupervised morphable model for each category, not just for faces.
Disentanglement without paying for it in image quality

The headline empirical result is that all of this control is essentially free in FID. On FFHQ faces at 256-squared, StyleMorph reaches an FID of 7.91, sitting comfortably among the strongest 3D-aware GANs. The comparison that matters most is against Disentangled3D, the only prior method that also represents shape with a deformable template: StyleMorph's 7.91 is far ahead of its 28.18, and StyleMorph additionally separates foreground from background, which that method does not.

en.caption: Table 1. FID at 256-squared on FFHQ and AFHQ (lower is better). StyleMorph is competitive with the best hybrids while adding full four-way disentanglement and a learned deformable template. A dash means the paper does not report that split. EG3D uses weak 3D supervision (a pre-trained pose estimator) and offers no factor disentanglement; Disentangled3D is the only other method with a deformable template.

en.text: On animals the story repeats: 4.29 on Cats, 3.49 on Wild, and 13.95 on Dogs. EG3D posts lower raw FID on faces, but it leans on a pre-trained pose estimator for weak 3D supervision and offers none of StyleMorph's factor control, so the two are not doing the same job. The point of the table is not to top every column, but to show that adding a learned template and four-way editability does not force a quality tax.
Editing real photographs, not just samples

Disentangled control is most useful when you can point it at a real image. By inverting the pipeline, StyleMorph recovers the latent codes and underlying 3D structure of a genuine input photo, and then re-renders it under new pose, foreground, background, or shape, each dial turned independently.

en.caption: Figure 8. Editing a real photo by inversion. StyleMorph inverts a target image (left) into its latent codes and recovers the underlying 3D structure, then re-renders it under new pose, foreground, background, and shape, each controlled independently.

en.text: What the ablations confirm

Under a fair 96-hour training budget, the ablations isolate each design choice. Swapping TOCS for plain NOCS, while keeping everything else identical, worsens FID from 8.31 to 8.90 and visibly blurs the conditioning signal, confirming that template-space coordinates, not just object coordinates, are what sharpen both quality and disentanglement. Removing the deformable module in favor of a direct occupancy network keeps FID similar but wrecks shape and appearance consistency. And switching from late fusion to early fusion nudges FID down slightly but hurts alpha consistency (88.65% to 85.87%), letting foreground and background bleed together, which is why StyleMorph keeps them separate until the final composite.

There is an honest trade-off worth naming. Directly optimizing a differentiable view-consistency loss does improve that metric substantially (from 15.84 to 8.12), but it costs image quality, pushing FID up to 12.31. StyleMorph's default configuration chooses photorealism over squeezing out the last of view consistency, a reasonable call, but one the paper is transparent about rather than hiding.
Takeaway

StyleMorph delivers morphable-model control inside a state-of-the-art image generator, learned entirely from ordinary 2D photos with no 3D scans, pose labels, or predefined template. By morphing a learned canonical template and rendering it into a purely geometric TOCS map, it hands a StyleGAN renderer a clean geometric signal, so shape, pose, foreground appearance, and background can each be edited on their own without sacrificing photorealism.

The broader significance is that StyleMorph effectively builds an unsupervised 3D morphable model for general object categories. Where classical morphable models required scanning rigs and existed almost exclusively for human faces, here the template and its space of deformations are discovered by backpropagation from an unlabeled image collection. That extends the fine-grained controllability visual-effects artists have long relied on from faces to cats, dogs, and wild animals, and it puts editable, category-general 3D-aware synthesis within reach of anyone with a folder of photos rather than a capture studio.

The boundaries are the usual ones for this line of work. Results are demonstrated on single-object, roughly centered categories, and the ablations are honest about a measurable quality-versus-view-consistency trade-off rather than a free lunch on both. But as a demonstration that disentanglement and photorealism can coexist, and that a morphable model can be learned rather than hand-built, StyleMorph is a clean and genuinely useful step toward controllable generative modelling.

zh.text: 如今的 3D-aware GAN 能生成质量极高、视角一致的人像，但它们生成的图像几乎是「不可编辑」的。因为这类模型把几何和外观揉进了同一套隐编码里，你想转一下人脸的角度，往往连身份也会跟着变；想换个背景，前景人物也会被扰动。画面很漂亮，可是控制旋钮全都黏在了一起。
图形学界其实早就解决了「控制」这件事，靠的是 3D 可变形模型（3D Morphable Model，简称 3DMM），它是影视特效与 AR 虚拟形象背后的主力工具，能给美术师提供姿态、表情、外观各自独立的旋钮。问题出在怎么造出这样一个模型：传统 3DMM 需要 3D 扫描设备，还要在大量样本之间做繁琐的手工对齐，这正是它长期以来基本只覆盖人脸这一个类别的原因。

来自 University College London 与 Alan Turing Institute 的 StyleMorph 提出了一个问题：能不能把 3DMM 式的控制能力搬进现代生成器，而且只从无结构的 2D 照片里学出来？他们给出的答案，是一个能把图像的四个因素干净拆开的模型，即物体的 3D 形状、相机姿态、前景外观和背景，每一个都可以独立编辑；与此同时，它的图像质量还能与那些完全不提供这种控制的最强 3D-aware GAN 相媲美。

zh.caption: 图1 StyleMorph 的解耦控制。从最左侧的一个合成样本出发，每一列只改变一个因素：姿态、形状、前景外观或背景，最右列则同时改变全部四个因素。几何条件信号（最上和最下行）在前景、背景两列中保持不变，因此这两处变化完全来自各自的外观编码。

zh.text: 论文地址：https://openreview.net/forum?id=Ojpb1y8jflw  ·  项目主页：https://stylemorph.github.io/stylemorph/
为什么 3D-aware GAN 会「纠缠」，而可变形模型能带来什么

从 GIRAFFE 到 EG3D，近年这批 3D-aware GAN 的真实感来自一个共同做法：把 3D 先验直接内置进生成器，用神经辐射场或隐式占据网络以体渲染的方式绘制场景，于是不同视角天然保持一致。代价就是「纠缠」。一个 style 向量或一份共享的特征体，会同时驱动形状和纹理，你根本没有一个入口能只改一个因素而不动其它。一些混合方法实现了部分解耦，但都没有学出一个可复用、可跨类别、可morph的形状模型。
而可变形模型恰恰就是这块缺失的拼图：一个标准模板，加上一套学到的形变空间，把模板 warp 成每一个具体实例。如果能在没有 3D 监督的情况下，为任意类别得到这样一个模型，就能同时拿到两个世界的好处，既有 GAN 的照片级真实感，又有 3DMM 那种「精准可编辑」。StyleMorph 的贡献，正是让这个可变形模型本身成为网络通过反向传播、只从 2D 图像里学出来的东西。
核心思路：把所有几何信息压进一个纯几何瓶颈

StyleMorph 由两半组成，它们在一个刻意设计得很窄的接口处相接。第一半是负责几何的「可变形渲染器」（Morphable Renderer）。它把一个不含形变的物体学成一个常量隐式场，存放在一个标准的模板空间里。一个由形状编码驱动的 SIREN 形变场，会给每条相机光线加上一个预测出的偏移量，把它从世界空间 warp 到模板空间，即 r̂(t) = r(t) + g_s(r(t))。沿光线积分模板坐标，就得到一张 2D 图，作者称之为 TOCS 图（Template Object Coordinates，模板物体坐标）。

TOCS 是全文的概念核心。它是 Normalized Object Coordinates（NOCS）的一个可变形版本：每个表面点在模板空间里都有一个稳定的身份，因此这张图是对 3D 形状的一种「形变等变」描述子。关键在于，一张 TOCS 图是纯几何的。它编码了形状形变、相机姿态和透视投影三者叠加后的效果，却完全不含任何纹理或颜色信息。这就是所谓的瓶颈：把所有几何因素都逼着经过这一张 2D 图，且只让几何经过它，StyleMorph 就在结构上保证了外观必须从别处进入流程。

zh.caption: 图2 StyleMorph 的两个部分。左侧：模板形状、形状编码 z_s、相机姿态 (φ, θ) 与透视投影共同生成一张 2D TOCS 图，把所有几何变化收束到这一个瓶颈里。右侧：TOCS 图连同相互独立的前景 (z_fg) 与背景 (z_bg) 外观编码送入延迟神经渲染器（Deferred Neural Renderer），在判别器的监督下生成高分辨率图像。

zh.text: 第二半才是外观所在之处。一个基于 StyleGAN2 的延迟神经渲染器（Deferred Neural Renderer，DNR）接收几何 TOCS 图，再加上两个相互独立的外观编码，一个管前景物体、一个管背景场景，合成出高分辨率图像。前景和背景分别生成，最后通过一张预测出的 alpha 掩码「后融合」在一起，即 I = A ⊙ I_fg + (1 − A) ⊙ I_bg。由于形状和姿态只能经由 TOCS 图抵达渲染器，而两个外观编码又从不触碰几何，这四个因素在设计上就天然分开了，而不是靠某个正则化惩罚项硬凑出来的。

训练分两个阶段。第一阶段，可变形体渲染器被当作一个低分辨率（64²）的 RGBA 图像生成器来训练，从而学到一个真实的形状模型，其间只用到来自现成 Labels4free 掩码的弱轮廓监督。第二阶段，冻结这个渲染器并剪掉它的 RGB 分支，此时它只负责输出 64² 的 TOCS 图；DNR 则在全分辨率下训练，学着把这些 TOCS 图连同外观编码变成照片级的输出。这样分工，让昂贵的体渲染模型保持小而省，而由 2D 渲染器来扛分辨率。
解耦真的成立吗
第一项检验，是看学到的形状空间是否足够丰富，以及渲染器是否真的尊重它。固定视角和外观编码、只改变形状编码，理应改变脸型与发型的几何，同时让渲染出的纹理与新形状对齐。

zh.caption: 图5 固定视角下的形状控制。四个不同的形状编码产生四张不同的 TOCS 图（对应不同发型和脸型），渲染出的 RGB 与之紧密对齐。画在模板坐标上的等值线（equicontours）显示出跨形状仍然成立的稠密表面对应关系。

zh.text: 等值线把这一点说得很清楚：同一个模板坐标，在差异很大的不同人脸上，都会落在同一个语义位置上，而这正是一个真正的可变形模型所应保证的。下一项检验，是完整的四因素编辑，以及它能否推广到人脸之外、那些经典 3DMM 从未覆盖过的类别。

zh.caption: 图6 在人脸、猫、野生动物上逐一独立编辑单个因素。从源样本（黄框）出发，StyleMorph 在保持其余因素不变的前提下，分别改变形状（绿框）、前景外观（蓝框）和背景（红框）。

zh.text: 改变前景编码，会在不移动几何的情况下给对象换一套外观；改变背景编码，会在不触碰对象的情况下重绘场景；改变形状编码，则改变底层的 3D 形态。在猫和野生动物上也是同样的表现，这说明 StyleMorph 实际上为每个类别都学到了一个无监督的可变形模型，而不只是针对人脸。
拿到解耦，却几乎没有牺牲画质

最亮眼的实验结论是：这一切控制能力，在 FID 上几乎是「免费」的。在 256² 分辨率的 FFHQ 人脸上，StyleMorph 的 FID 达到 7.91，稳稳处在最强一批 3D-aware GAN 之列。而最值得一比的对手是 Disentangled3D，它是此前唯一同样用可变形模板来表示形状的方法：StyleMorph 的 7.91 大幅领先于它的 28.18，而且 StyleMorph 还额外做到了前景与背景的分离，这一点是它所不具备的。

zh.caption: 表1 FFHQ 与 AFHQ 上 256² 分辨率的 FID（越低越好）。StyleMorph 在增加了完整四因素解耦和一个可学习的可变形模板的同时，仍与最强的混合方法保持竞争力。横线表示论文未报告该项。EG3D 使用弱 3D 监督（一个预训练的姿态估计器）且不提供任何因素解耦；Disentangled3D 是另一个唯一带可变形模板的方法。

zh.text: 在动物上故事同样成立：Cats 4.29、Wild 3.49、Dogs 13.95。EG3D 在人脸上的原始 FID 更低，但它依赖一个预训练的姿态估计器来提供弱 3D 监督，也完全不具备 StyleMorph 的因素控制，所以两者并不是在做同一件事。这张表想说明的，不是要在每一列都拿第一，而是：加入一个可学习的模板和四向可编辑能力，并不需要以画质为代价。
编辑的是真实照片，而不只是采样结果
解耦控制最有用的场景，是能把它对准一张真实图像。通过反演（inversion）整条流程，StyleMorph 能恢复出一张真实输入照片的隐编码和底层 3D 结构，再以每个旋钮各自独立的方式，为它重新渲染出新的姿态、前景、背景或形状。

zh.caption: 图8 通过反演编辑真实照片。StyleMorph 把目标图像（最左）反演回它的隐编码并恢复出底层 3D 结构，随后以独立可控的方式改变姿态、前景、背景和形状，重新渲染。

zh.text: 消融实验证实了什么

在统一的 96 小时训练预算下，消融实验逐一隔离出每个设计选择的作用。在其它部分完全不变的前提下，把 TOCS 换成普通的 NOCS，会让 FID 从 8.31 变差到 8.90，条件信号也明显变糊，这说明真正让画质和解耦都变锐利的，是「模板空间坐标」，而不仅仅是物体坐标。去掉可变形模块、改用一个直接的占据网络，FID 相近，但形状与外观一致性会被严重破坏。而从后融合（late fusion）改为前融合（early fusion），FID 会略微下降，却损害了 alpha 一致性（88.65% 降到 85.87%），让前景和背景相互渗透，这也正是 StyleMorph 坚持把两者分开、直到最终合成才融合的原因。
还有一个值得如实点明的取舍。直接优化一个可微的视角一致性损失，确实能把该指标大幅改善（从 15.84 降到 8.12），但代价是画质，会把 FID 推高到 12.31。StyleMorph 的默认配置选择了照片级真实感，而不是把最后一点视角一致性也榨出来，这是一个合理的取舍，而论文对此是坦诚说明的，并没有回避。
小结
StyleMorph 在一个当前顶尖的图像生成器内部，交付了 3DMM 式的控制能力，而且完全从普通的 2D 照片里学到，不需要任何 3D 扫描、姿态标注或预定义模板。通过对一个学到的标准模板做形变，并把它渲染成一张纯几何的 TOCS 图，它给 StyleGAN 渲染器递上了一个干净的几何信号，于是形状、姿态、前景外观和背景都能各自独立编辑，而不牺牲照片级真实感。
更宏观地看，StyleMorph 实际上为一般物体类别构建了一个无监督的 3D 可变形模型。经典的可变形模型需要扫描设备，也几乎只存在于人脸这一个类别；而在这里，模板及其形变空间是通过反向传播、从一批无标注图像中自行学到的。这把影视特效美术师长期依赖的那种精细可控性，从人脸拓展到了猫、狗和野生动物，也让「可编辑、可跨类别的 3D-aware 合成」变得只需要一批照片、而不再需要一间采集棚。
它的边界也是这条研究线上常见的那些：结果都展示在单物体、大致居中的类别上，消融实验也如实呈现了画质与视角一致性之间可测量的取舍，并非两头通吃的免费午餐。但作为一个例证，它说明了解耦与照片级真实感可以共存，也说明可变形模型可以被「学出来」而不必「手工搭出来」，这让 StyleMorph 成为迈向可控生成建模的一个干净而实用的步骤。

en.title: StyleMorph: Learning a Morphable 3D Model from 2D Photos Alone
en.subtitle: ICLR 2023 · UCL and the Alan Turing Institute give a StyleGAN clean, independent dials for shape, pose, and appearance, learned from ordinary 2D photos with no 3D scans and no template built by hand.

zh.title: ICLR 2023 | 只用2D照片，学出一个能任意拆开控制的3D可变形生成器
zh.subtitle: UCL 与 Alan Turing Institute 提出 StyleMorph：无需任何3D扫描、姿态标注或手工模板，就让 StyleGAN 拥有形状、姿态与外观的独立旋钮。

en.text: Modern 3D-aware GANs make gorgeous, view-consistent portraits. What they do not make is editable ones. Because their latent codes fuse geometry and appearance into a single hybrid representation, you cannot rotate a generated face without also nudging its identity, or swap the background without disturbing the subject. The pixels are beautiful; the control knobs are glued together.

The graphics world solved the control problem decades ago with 3D Morphable Models (3DMMs), the workhorse behind visual-effects pipelines and AR avatars. A 3DMM hands the artist clean, separate dials for pose, expression, and appearance. The catch is how you build one: classical 3DMMs demand 3D scanning rigs and painstaking manual alignment across a subject population, which is exactly why they mostly exist for a single category, the human face.

StyleMorph, from University College London and the Alan Turing Institute, asks whether we can get morphable-model control inside a modern generator while learning everything from nothing but unstructured 2D photos. The answer is a model that cleanly pulls apart four factors of an image, the object's 3D shape, the camera pose, the foreground appearance, and the background, and lets you edit each one independently, all while matching the image quality of the strongest 3D-aware GANs that offer none of this control.

en.caption: Figure 1. Disentangled control in StyleMorph. Starting from one synthesized sample (far left), each column changes a single factor: pose, shape, foreground appearance, or background. The rightmost column combines all four. The geometric conditioning signal (top and bottom rows) stays fixed across the foreground and background edits, so those two changes come purely from the appearance codes.

en.text: Paper: https://openreview.net/forum?id=Ojpb1y8jflw  ·  Project page: https://stylemorph.github.io/stylemorph/

zh.text: 如今的 3D-aware GAN 能生成质量极高、视角一致的人像，但它们生成的图像几乎是「不可编辑」的。因为这类模型把几何和外观揉进了同一套隐编码里，你想转一下人脸的角度，往往连身份也会跟着变；想换个背景，前景人物也会被扰动。画面很漂亮，可是控制旋钮全都黏在了一起。
图形学界其实早就解决了「控制」这件事，靠的是 3D 可变形模型（3D Morphable Model，简称 3DMM），它是影视特效与 AR 虚拟形象背后的主力工具，能给美术师提供姿态、表情、外观各自独立的旋钮。问题出在怎么造出这样一个模型：传统 3DMM 需要 3D 扫描设备，还要在大量样本之间做繁琐的手工对齐，这正是它长期以来基本只覆盖人脸这一个类别的原因。

来自 University College London 与 Alan Turing Institute 的 StyleMorph 提出了一个问题：能不能把 3DMM 式的控制能力搬进现代生成器，而且只从无结构的 2D 照片里学出来？他们给出的答案，是一个能把图像的四个因素干净拆开的模型，即物体的 3D 形状、相机姿态、前景外观和背景，每一个都可以独立编辑；与此同时，它的图像质量还能与那些完全不提供这种控制的最强 3D-aware GAN 相媲美。

zh.caption: 图1 StyleMorph 的解耦控制。从最左侧的一个合成样本出发，每一列只改变一个因素：姿态、形状、前景外观或背景，最右列则同时改变全部四个因素。几何条件信号（最上和最下行）在前景、背景两列中保持不变，因此这两处变化完全来自各自的外观编码。

zh.text: 论文地址：https://openreview.net/forum?id=Ojpb1y8jflw  ·  项目主页：https://stylemorph.github.io/stylemorph/

en.title: StyleMorph: Learning a Morphable 3D Model from 2D Photos Alone
en.subtitle: ICLR 2023 · UCL and the Alan Turing Institute give a StyleGAN clean, independent dials for shape, pose, and appearance, learned from ordinary 2D photos with no 3D scans and no template built by hand.

zh.title: ICLR 2023 | 只用2D照片，学出一个能任意拆开控制的3D可变形生成器
zh.subtitle: UCL 与 Alan Turing Institute 提出 StyleMorph：无需任何3D扫描、姿态标注或手工模板，就让 StyleGAN 拥有形状、姿态与外观的独立旋钮。

en.caption: Figure 1. Disentangled control in StyleMorph. Starting from one synthesized sample (far left), each column changes a single factor: pose, shape, foreground appearance, or background. The rightmost column combines all four. The geometric conditioning signal (top and bottom rows) stays fixed across the foreground and background edits, so those two changes come purely from the appearance codes.

en.text: Why 3D-aware GANs entangle, and what a morphable model buys you

The recent wave of 3D-aware GANs, from GIRAFFE to EG3D, earns its realism by baking a 3D inductive bias into the generator: a neural radiance field or an implicit occupancy network renders the scene volumetrically, so different viewpoints stay consistent by construction. The price is entanglement. A single style vector, or a shared feature volume, drives shape and texture together, so there is no place to reach in and change one factor without touching the others. Some hybrids add partial disentanglement, but none of them learn a reusable, category-general shape model that you can morph at will.

A morphable model is exactly that missing piece: a canonical template plus a learned space of deformations that warp it into each individual instance. If you could obtain one for arbitrary categories without 3D supervision, you would get both worlds, the photorealism of a GAN and the surgical editability of a 3DMM. StyleMorph's contribution is to make the morphable model itself something the network discovers by backpropagation, from 2D images alone.

zh.caption: 图1 StyleMorph 的解耦控制。从最左侧的一个合成样本出发，每一列只改变一个因素：姿态、形状、前景外观或背景，最右列则同时改变全部四个因素。几何条件信号（最上和最下行）在前景、背景两列中保持不变，因此这两处变化完全来自各自的外观编码。

zh.text: 为什么 3D-aware GAN 会「纠缠」，而可变形模型能带来什么

从 GIRAFFE 到 EG3D，近年这批 3D-aware GAN 的真实感来自一个共同做法：把 3D 先验直接内置进生成器，用神经辐射场或隐式占据网络以体渲染的方式绘制场景，于是不同视角天然保持一致。代价就是「纠缠」。一个 style 向量或一份共享的特征体，会同时驱动形状和纹理，你根本没有一个入口能只改一个因素而不动其它。一些混合方法实现了部分解耦，但都没有学出一个可复用、可跨类别、可morph的形状模型。
而可变形模型恰恰就是这块缺失的拼图：一个标准模板，加上一套学到的形变空间，把模板 warp 成每一个具体实例。如果能在没有 3D 监督的情况下，为任意类别得到这样一个模型，就能同时拿到两个世界的好处，既有 GAN 的照片级真实感，又有 3DMM 那种「精准可编辑」。StyleMorph 的贡献，正是让这个可变形模型本身成为网络通过反向传播、只从 2D 图像里学出来的东西。

zh.subtitle: UCL 与 Alan Turing Institute 提出 StyleMorph：无需任何3D扫描、姿态标注或手工模板，就让 StyleGAN 拥有形状、姿态与外观的独立旋钮。

en.caption: Figure 1. Disentangled control in StyleMorph. Starting from one synthesized sample (far left), each column changes a single factor: pose, shape, foreground appearance, or background. The rightmost column combines all four. The geometric conditioning signal (top and bottom rows) stays fixed across the foreground and background edits, so those two changes come purely from the appearance codes.

en.text: Disentanglement without paying for it in image quality

The headline empirical result is that all of this control is essentially free in FID. On FFHQ faces at 256-squared, StyleMorph reaches an FID of 7.91, sitting comfortably among the strongest 3D-aware GANs. The comparison that matters most is against Disentangled3D, the only prior method that also represents shape with a deformable template: StyleMorph's 7.91 is far ahead of its 28.18, and StyleMorph additionally separates foreground from background, which that method does not.

en.caption: Table 1. FID at 256-squared on FFHQ and AFHQ (lower is better). StyleMorph is competitive with the best hybrids while adding full four-way disentanglement and a learned deformable template. A dash means the paper does not report that split. EG3D uses weak 3D supervision (a pre-trained pose estimator) and offers no factor disentanglement; Disentangled3D is the only other method with a deformable template.

en.text: On animals the story repeats: 4.29 on Cats, 3.49 on Wild, and 13.95 on Dogs. EG3D posts lower raw FID on faces, but it leans on a pre-trained pose estimator for weak 3D supervision and offers none of StyleMorph's factor control, so the two are not doing the same job. The point of the table is not to top every column, but to show that adding a learned template and four-way editability does not force a quality tax.

拿到解耦，却几乎没有牺牲画质

最亮眼的实验结论是：这一切控制能力，在 FID 上几乎是「免费」的。在 256² 分辨率的 FFHQ 人脸上，StyleMorph 的 FID 达到 7.91，稳稳处在最强一批 3D-aware GAN 之列。而最值得一比的对手是 Disentangled3D，它是此前唯一同样用可变形模板来表示形状的方法：StyleMorph 的 7.91 大幅领先于它的 28.18，而且 StyleMorph 还额外做到了前景与背景的分离，这一点是它所不具备的。

zh.caption: 表1 FFHQ 与 AFHQ 上 256² 分辨率的 FID（越低越好）。StyleMorph 在增加了完整四因素解耦和一个可学习的可变形模板的同时，仍与最强的混合方法保持竞争力。横线表示论文未报告该项。EG3D 使用弱 3D 监督（一个预训练的姿态估计器）且不提供任何因素解耦；Disentangled3D 是另一个唯一带可变形模板的方法。

zh.text: 在动物上故事同样成立：Cats 4.29、Wild 3.49、Dogs 13.95。EG3D 在人脸上的原始 FID 更低，但它依赖一个预训练的姿态估计器来提供弱 3D 监督，也完全不具备 StyleMorph 的因素控制，所以两者并不是在做同一件事。这张表想说明的，不是要在每一列都拿第一，而是：加入一个可学习的模板和四向可编辑能力，并不需要以画质为代价。

en.title: StyleMorph: Learning a Morphable 3D Model from 2D Photos Alone
en.subtitle: ICLR 2023 · UCL and the Alan Turing Institute give a StyleGAN clean, independent dials for shape, pose, and appearance, learned from ordinary 2D photos with no 3D scans and no template built by hand.

zh.title: ICLR 2023 | 只用2D照片，学出一个能任意拆开控制的3D可变形生成器
zh.subtitle: UCL 与 Alan Turing Institute 提出 StyleMorph：无需任何3D扫描、姿态标注或手工模板，就让 StyleGAN 拥有形状、姿态与外观的独立旋钮。

en.text: The idea: funnel all geometry through one purely geometric bottleneck

StyleMorph has two halves that meet at a single, deliberately narrow interface. The first half is a Morphable Renderer that handles geometry. It learns a deformation-free object as a constant implicit field living in a canonical template space. A deformation field built on SIREN, driven by a shape code, warps each camera ray from world space into that template space by adding a predicted offset, r-hat(t) = r(t) + g_s(r(t)). Integrating the template coordinates along each ray produces a 2D map the authors call a TOCS map, for Template Object Coordinates.

TOCS is the conceptual heart of the paper. It is a deformable cousin of Normalized Object Coordinates: every surface point carries a stable identity in template space, so the map is a deformation-equivariant descriptor of 3D shape. Crucially, a TOCS map is exclusively geometric. It encodes the compounded effect of shape deformation, camera pose, and perspective projection, and nothing at all about texture or color. That is the bottleneck: by forcing every geometric factor through this one 2D image, and nothing else through it, StyleMorph guarantees that appearance has to enter the pipeline somewhere else.

en.caption: Figure 2. The two halves of StyleMorph. Left: a template shape, a shape code z_s, camera pose (phi, theta), and perspective projection are combined into a single 2D TOCS map that bottlenecks all geometric variation. Right: the TOCS map, plus separate foreground (z_fg) and background (z_bg) appearance codes, drives a Deferred Neural Renderer, trained against a discriminator, to produce a high-resolution image.

en.text: The second half is where appearance lives. A Deferred Neural Renderer (DNR) built on StyleGAN2 takes the geometric TOCS map together with two independent appearance codes, one for the foreground object and one for the background scene, and synthesizes a high-resolution image. Foreground and background are generated separately and composited late, through a predicted alpha mask, I = A * I_fg + (1 - A) * I_bg. Because shape and pose can only reach the renderer through the TOCS map, and the two appearance codes never touch geometry, the four factors come out cleanly separated by design rather than by a regularization penalty.

Training runs in two stages. In stage one, the deformable volume renderer is trained as a low-resolution 64-squared RGBA image generator, so it learns a realistic shape model, with only weak silhouette supervision from off-the-shelf Labels4free masks. In stage two, that renderer is frozen and its RGB block pruned; it now serves only to emit 64-squared TOCS maps, while the DNR is trained at full resolution to turn those maps plus appearance codes into photorealistic output. Splitting the work this way lets the expensive volumetric model stay small and cheap, while the 2D renderer carries the resolution.
Disentanglement without paying for it in image quality

The headline empirical result is that all of this control is essentially free in FID. On FFHQ faces at 256-squared, StyleMorph reaches an FID of 7.91, sitting comfortably among the strongest 3D-aware GANs. The comparison that matters most is against Disentangled3D, the only prior method that also represents shape with a deformable template: StyleMorph's 7.91 is far ahead of its 28.18, and StyleMorph additionally separates foreground from background, which that method does not.

en.caption: Table 1. FID at 256-squared on FFHQ and AFHQ (lower is better). StyleMorph is competitive with the best hybrids while adding full four-way disentanglement and a learned deformable template. A dash means the paper does not report that split. EG3D uses weak 3D supervision (a pre-trained pose estimator) and offers no factor disentanglement; Disentangled3D is the only other method with a deformable template.

en.text: On animals the story repeats: 4.29 on Cats, 3.49 on Wild, and 13.95 on Dogs. EG3D posts lower raw FID on faces, but it leans on a pre-trained pose estimator for weak 3D supervision and offers none of StyleMorph's factor control, so the two are not doing the same job. The point of the table is not to top every column, but to show that adding a learned template and four-way editability does not force a quality tax.

zh.text: 编辑的是真实照片，而不只是采样结果
解耦控制最有用的场景，是能把它对准一张真实图像。通过反演（inversion）整条流程，StyleMorph 能恢复出一张真实输入照片的隐编码和底层 3D 结构，再以每个旋钮各自独立的方式，为它重新渲染出新的姿态、前景、背景或形状。

zh.caption: 图8 通过反演编辑真实照片。StyleMorph 把目标图像（最左）反演回它的隐编码并恢复出底层 3D 结构，随后以独立可控的方式改变姿态、前景、背景和形状，重新渲染。

zh.text: 小结
StyleMorph 在一个当前顶尖的图像生成器内部，交付了 3DMM 式的控制能力，而且完全从普通的 2D 照片里学到，不需要任何 3D 扫描、姿态标注或预定义模板。通过对一个学到的标准模板做形变，并把它渲染成一张纯几何的 TOCS 图，它给 StyleGAN 渲染器递上了一个干净的几何信号，于是形状、姿态、前景外观和背景都能各自独立编辑，而不牺牲照片级真实感。
更宏观地看，StyleMorph 实际上为一般物体类别构建了一个无监督的 3D 可变形模型。经典的可变形模型需要扫描设备，也几乎只存在于人脸这一个类别；而在这里，模板及其形变空间是通过反向传播、从一批无标注图像中自行学到的。这把影视特效美术师长期依赖的那种精细可控性，从人脸拓展到了猫、狗和野生动物，也让「可编辑、可跨类别的 3D-aware 合成」变得只需要一批照片、而不再需要一间采集棚。
它的边界也是这条研究线上常见的那些：结果都展示在单物体、大致居中的类别上，消融实验也如实呈现了画质与视角一致性之间可测量的取舍，并非两头通吃的免费午餐。但作为一个例证，它说明了解耦与照片级真实感可以共存，也说明可变形模型可以被「学出来」而不必「手工搭出来」，这让 StyleMorph 成为迈向可控生成建模的一个干净而实用的步骤。

en.title: StyleMorph: Learning a Morphable 3D Model from 2D Photos Alone
en.subtitle: ICLR 2023 · UCL and the Alan Turing Institute give a StyleGAN clean, independent dials for shape, pose, and appearance, learned from ordinary 2D photos with no 3D scans and no template built by hand.

zh.title: ICLR 2023 | 只用2D照片，学出一个能任意拆开控制的3D可变形生成器
zh.subtitle: UCL 与 Alan Turing Institute 提出 StyleMorph：无需任何3D扫描、姿态标注或手工模板，就让 StyleGAN 拥有形状、姿态与外观的独立旋钮。

en.caption: Figure 1. Disentangled control in StyleMorph. Starting from one synthesized sample (far left), each column changes a single factor: pose, shape, foreground appearance, or background. The rightmost column combines all four. The geometric conditioning signal (top and bottom rows) stays fixed across the foreground and background edits, so those two changes come purely from the appearance codes.

en.text: What the ablations confirm

Under a fair 96-hour training budget, the ablations isolate each design choice. Swapping TOCS for plain NOCS, while keeping everything else identical, worsens FID from 8.31 to 8.90 and visibly blurs the conditioning signal, confirming that template-space coordinates, not just object coordinates, are what sharpen both quality and disentanglement. Removing the deformable module in favor of a direct occupancy network keeps FID similar but wrecks shape and appearance consistency. And switching from late fusion to early fusion nudges FID down slightly but hurts alpha consistency (88.65% to 85.87%), letting foreground and background bleed together, which is why StyleMorph keeps them separate until the final composite.

There is an honest trade-off worth naming. Directly optimizing a differentiable view-consistency loss does improve that metric substantially (from 15.84 to 8.12), but it costs image quality, pushing FID up to 12.31. StyleMorph's default configuration chooses photorealism over squeezing out the last of view consistency, a reasonable call, but one the paper is transparent about rather than hiding.

zh.caption: 图1 StyleMorph 的解耦控制。从最左侧的一个合成样本出发，每一列只改变一个因素：姿态、形状、前景外观或背景，最右列则同时改变全部四个因素。几何条件信号（最上和最下行）在前景、背景两列中保持不变，因此这两处变化完全来自各自的外观编码。

zh.text: 消融实验证实了什么

在统一的 96 小时训练预算下，消融实验逐一隔离出每个设计选择的作用。在其它部分完全不变的前提下，把 TOCS 换成普通的 NOCS，会让 FID 从 8.31 变差到 8.90，条件信号也明显变糊，这说明真正让画质和解耦都变锐利的，是「模板空间坐标」，而不仅仅是物体坐标。去掉可变形模块、改用一个直接的占据网络，FID 相近，但形状与外观一致性会被严重破坏。而从后融合（late fusion）改为前融合（early fusion），FID 会略微下降，却损害了 alpha 一致性（88.65% 降到 85.87%），让前景和背景相互渗透，这也正是 StyleMorph 坚持把两者分开、直到最终合成才融合的原因。
还有一个值得如实点明的取舍。直接优化一个可微的视角一致性损失，确实能把该指标大幅改善（从 15.84 降到 8.12），但代价是画质，会把 FID 推高到 12.31。StyleMorph 的默认配置选择了照片级真实感，而不是把最后一点视角一致性也榨出来，这是一个合理的取舍，而论文对此是坦诚说明的，并没有回避。

en.title: StyleMorph: Learning a Morphable 3D Model from 2D Photos Alone
en.subtitle: ICLR 2023 · UCL and the Alan Turing Institute give a StyleGAN clean, independent dials for shape, pose, and appearance, learned from ordinary 2D photos with no 3D scans and no template built by hand.

zh.title: ICLR 2023 | 只用2D照片，学出一个能任意拆开控制的3D可变形生成器
zh.subtitle: UCL 与 Alan Turing Institute 提出 StyleMorph：无需任何3D扫描、姿态标注或手工模板，就让 StyleGAN 拥有形状、姿态与外观的独立旋钮。

en.caption: Figure 1. Disentangled control in StyleMorph. Starting from one synthesized sample (far left), each column changes a single factor: pose, shape, foreground appearance, or background. The rightmost column combines all four. The geometric conditioning signal (top and bottom rows) stays fixed across the foreground and background edits, so those two changes come purely from the appearance codes.

en.text: Takeaway

StyleMorph delivers morphable-model control inside a state-of-the-art image generator, learned entirely from ordinary 2D photos with no 3D scans, pose labels, or predefined template. By morphing a learned canonical template and rendering it into a purely geometric TOCS map, it hands a StyleGAN renderer a clean geometric signal, so shape, pose, foreground appearance, and background can each be edited on their own without sacrificing photorealism.

The broader significance is that StyleMorph effectively builds an unsupervised 3D morphable model for general object categories. Where classical morphable models required scanning rigs and existed almost exclusively for human faces, here the template and its space of deformations are discovered by backpropagation from an unlabeled image collection. That extends the fine-grained controllability visual-effects artists have long relied on from faces to cats, dogs, and wild animals, and it puts editable, category-general 3D-aware synthesis within reach of anyone with a folder of photos rather than a capture studio.

The boundaries are the usual ones for this line of work. Results are demonstrated on single-object, roughly centered categories, and the ablations are honest about a measurable quality-versus-view-consistency trade-off rather than a free lunch on both. But as a demonstration that disentanglement and photorealism can coexist, and that a morphable model can be learned rather than hand-built, StyleMorph is a clean and genuinely useful step toward controllable generative modelling.

zh.caption: 图1 StyleMorph 的解耦控制。从最左侧的一个合成样本出发，每一列只改变一个因素：姿态、形状、前景外观或背景，最右列则同时改变全部四个因素。几何条件信号（最上和最下行）在前景、背景两列中保持不变，因此这两处变化完全来自各自的外观编码。

zh.text: 拿到解耦，却几乎没有牺牲画质

最亮眼的实验结论是：这一切控制能力，在 FID 上几乎是「免费」的。在 256² 分辨率的 FFHQ 人脸上，StyleMorph 的 FID 达到 7.91，稳稳处在最强一批 3D-aware GAN 之列。而最值得一比的对手是 Disentangled3D，它是此前唯一同样用可变形模板来表示形状的方法：StyleMorph 的 7.91 大幅领先于它的 28.18，而且 StyleMorph 还额外做到了前景与背景的分离，这一点是它所不具备的。

zh.caption: 表1 FFHQ 与 AFHQ 上 256² 分辨率的 FID（越低越好）。StyleMorph 在增加了完整四因素解耦和一个可学习的可变形模板的同时，仍与最强的混合方法保持竞争力。横线表示论文未报告该项。EG3D 使用弱 3D 监督（一个预训练的姿态估计器）且不提供任何因素解耦；Disentangled3D 是另一个唯一带可变形模板的方法。

zh.text: 在动物上故事同样成立：Cats 4.29、Wild 3.49、Dogs 13.95。EG3D 在人脸上的原始 FID 更低，但它依赖一个预训练的姿态估计器来提供弱 3D 监督，也完全不具备 StyleMorph 的因素控制，所以两者并不是在做同一件事。这张表想说明的，不是要在每一列都拿第一，而是：加入一个可学习的模板和四向可编辑能力，并不需要以画质为代价。
